allOf.description: Configuration to store data points in a local file when connection to CDF is lost

influx.description: Use influxdb as a buffer. Requires `influx` to be configured. This is intended to be used if there is a local influxdb instance running. If points are received on non-historical points while the connection to CDF is down, they are read from influxdb once the connection is restored

enabled.description: Set to `true` to enable the failure buffer

max-buffer-size.description: Maximum size of buffer file in bytes

influx-state-store.description: If `state-storage` is configured, this can be used to store the ranges of points buffered in influxdb, so that they can be recovered even if the extractor goes down

event-path.description: Path to a binary file for storing events. The two buffer paths must be different.

datapoint-path.description: Path to a binary file. There is no safety, and a bad write can corrupt the file, but it is very fast.
